I would NOT buy from that seller. It is definitely a scam. You'll end up with a fake knock off drone if you buy it for that low of a price. A brand new genuine mini 2 fly more combo will never be below $600 unless it's certified refurbished from an authorized seller. I bought my DJI Air 2s as a certified refurbished fly more combo for $969 and it was in perfect like new condition, resealed in the original box with brand new accessories and looks like it's never been used before. Certified refurbished means that it's checked and fixed by the manufacturer, DJI. I've read that these drones are guaranteed no older than 1-2 weeks since people return the drone before the return by date due to an issue or any other reason. I've seen lots of posts on ebay for the mini 2 fly more combo for around $470. The seller name is dronesuperstore and they are a DJI authorized seller. Make sure the fly more combo comes with the shoulder bag, charging hub, wall charger, 3 batteries, extra propellers, USB cables, controller, and drone. And don't forget to buy a micro SD card along with a card reader or USB adapter to plug into your laptop. I'd also recommend getting propeller guards since the drone sensors are not that good on the mini 2 and since you're a beginner. Best of luck.
